prompt: Research current auth, draft two login redesign approaches, and wait for me before changing any code.
interpretation: You want a real picture of how login works today, two concrete redesign options with tradeoffs, and a hard stop before anyone edits the codebase.

nodes.label: Read current auth
nodes.summary: Collect how login, sessions, and password reset actually work in this repo.
nodes.instructions: Search the repo for auth routes, session storage, identity providers, and tests. Capture file paths and the current user-visible login flow.

nodes.label: Read product constraints
nodes.summary: Find product notes, tickets, and UX copy that constrain a login change.
nodes.instructions: Look for docs, tickets, and UI copy about login, signup, SSO, and account recovery. Note must-keep behaviors.

nodes.label: Summarize auth as-is
nodes.summary: Turn repo findings into a short as-is picture a human can check.
nodes.instructions: Write a plain-language as-is summary: entry points, identity sources, session lifetime, failure modes. Drop speculation.

nodes.label: Merge research
nodes.summary: One packet with as-is auth plus product constraints.
nodes.instructions: Merge both branches. Deduplicate facts. Flag conflicts between code and docs.

nodes.label: Pick two approaches
nodes.summary: Choose two redesigns that fit the constraints, not a menu of ten.
nodes.instructions: Select two approaches that both satisfy must-keep behaviors. Score them on risk, effort, and user impact.

nodes.label: Draft each approach
nodes.summary: Write a one-page design for each selected approach.
nodes.instructions: For each approach, draft scope, files likely to change, migration steps, and rollback. Do not edit application code.

nodes.label: Your review
nodes.summary: Nothing is implemented until you pick an approach.
nodes.instructions: Present both drafts. Capture approve, edit, or reject per approach, plus any preference notes.

nodes.label: Package the chosen plan
nodes.summary: Hand back the approved approach as the implementation brief.
nodes.instructions: Package the approved draft and preference notes. Ready for a later implementation run.

loops.until: each selected approach has a one-page draft
